purpose: Freeze the read-only localization audit boundary before implementing the executable audit. Localization audit validates canonical identity, Korean presentation overlays, and effective frontend display without translating, mutating, or re-deriving canonical data.

canonicalKey.rule: Localization sources may validate nameCn, tier, armyType, or status after soldierId resolution, but names, aliases, file order, and numeric patterns are never JOIN keys.

canonicalSoldierList.role: canonical identity and canonical Korean-name state

lowerTierPresentation.role: confirmed Korean frontend presentation for canonical tier 1-2 Soldiers

tier3ProvisionalPresentation.role: provisional Korean frontend presentation for tier-3 Soldiers whose exact Korean server name is unresolved

tier3ProvisionalValidation.role: existing evidence for the canonical-versus-provisional boundary

rules: A lower-tier presentation record may replace only the effective frontend nameKr and effective nameKrStatus; canonical Stage 5-8 identity remains unchanged.

A tier-3 provisional presentation record may replace only the effective frontend nameKr and effective nameKrStatus; canonical Stage 5-8 nameKr must remain null until the official Korean server name is confirmed.
When no presentation overlay applies, effective frontend localization falls through to the canonical Soldier record.
Presentation overlays never change soldierId, nameCn, tier, armyType, isSp, relations, combat data, release metadata, or canonical validationStatus.

confirmedCanonical.condition: nameKr is a non-empty string and nameKrStatus is confirmed
confirmedCanonical.meaning: Korean name is stored in canonical Soldier identity

lowerTierPresentationBackfill.condition: canonical tier is 1 or 2 and an exact lowerTierPresentation record exists
lowerTierPresentationBackfill.meaning: confirmed Korean display name is presentation-only and does not require canonical mutation

tier3Provisional.meaning: frontend may show the provisional Korean label, but it is not a confirmed canonical Korean name

requiredChecks: all presentation Soldier IDs resolve exactly once in the canonical list
lower-tier presentation coverage is 39 with exact tier and nameCn parity
tier-3 provisional presentation coverage is 2 with exact tier, armyType, and nameCn parity
no Soldier ID appears in both presentation overlays
tier-3 provisional canonical state remains null/unreleased/REVIEW
all presentation Korean display labels are non-empty

FAIL: provisional label promoted into canonical confirmed state without approved source transition
REVIEW: approved provisional display name remains unresolved
future stale provisional candidate pending official-name confirmation review

forbidden: Write localization results back into canonical Soldier data
Promote provisional display labels to confirmed canonical names automatically
Join by nameKr, nameCn, alias, array position, filename similarity, or ID arithmetic
Treat frontend display coverage as proof that canonical localization is confirmed
Treat canonical REVIEW caused by unresolved Korean naming as a semantic Soldier identity failure
Recompute Hero-Soldier relations or any non-localization semantics
Modify presentation files during audit execution
completion: Stage 0 is complete when the authoritative canonical source, presentation overlays, exact-ID matching rules, provisional-name boundary, frontend display precedence, read-only policy, Stage 1 minimum checks, and failure/review semantics are frozen without modifying existing localization or canonical data.
